data: What is the approximate value of the precision for the red curve in the right graph when the recall is 0.775?

The red curve represents the model with BiLM pretraining, while the blue curve represents the model without pretraining. The recall values range from approximately 0.7 to 0.875 on the x-axis, and the precision values range from approximately 0.8 to 0.94 on the y-axis. The recall value of 0.775 corresponds to a point on the x-axis. At this recall value, the red curve intersects with the y-axis at an approximate value of 0.85. Therefore, the approximate value of the precision for the red curve in the right graph when the recall is 0.775 is 0.85.
